description: The SPECIAL EDITION Xindi campaign follows Enterprise through the Expanse as Archer uncovers the weapon aimed at Earth, the fractured Xindi alliance and the Sphere Builders manipulating both sides.

s03e01.description: Spatial anomalies cripple Enterprise while raiders exploit the chaos, leading Archer to evidence of a larger Xindi operation.

s03e02.description: Archer discovers a colony manufacturing a key component of the Xindi weapon and must decide whether its civilians are enemies or unwitting suppliers.

s03e03.description: Archer awakens years after a neurological injury to a future in which Earth is gone and humanity is close to extinction.

s03e04.description: A rapidly aging clone created to save Tucker develops a life and identity of his own, turning a medical solution into an ethical crisis.

s03e05.description: Andorian commander Shran offers Archer help with a Xindi prototype, but his assistance carries strategic motives of its own.

s03e06.description: Enterprise uses an elaborate deception to convince a captured Xindi commander that years have passed and Archer is now his ally.

s03e07.description: A mysterious alien recovered from an anomaly brings warnings about the Expanse while tensions among the crew become unusually personal.

s03e08.description: Enterprise locates the Xindi weapon and Archer undertakes a near-suicidal mission as the ship faces overwhelming enemy forces.

s03e09.description: With Enterprise crippled and time running out, Archer considers crossing a moral line to obtain the parts needed to continue the mission.

s03e10.description: Tucker struggles with grief while Archer tries to persuade a Xindi ally that humanity is being manipulated by a hidden enemy.

s03e11.description: Enterprise encounters descendants of its own crew from a timeline where the ship was thrown more than a century into the past.

s03e12.description: Archer presents humanity's case directly to the divided Xindi Council while a covert mission targets the Sphere Builders' network.

s03e13.description: The Xindi alliance fractures as Archer races to stop the weapon and Enterprise pays heavily for every remaining hour.

s03e14.description: The mission to destroy the Xindi weapon reaches Earth while Enterprise attacks the sphere network sustaining the Expanse.
